SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID , T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T5.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SHARE_AMT*100 SHARE_AMT, T1.INV_AIM businessModel, T2.OUR_SHARE_AMT * 100 OUR_SHARE_AMT, T2.OUR_CPRICE_AMT , T2.OUR_FPRICE_AMT , T2.OUR_INT_AMT, T2.LENDIN_SHARE_AMT * 100, T2.LENDIN_CPRICE_AMT , T2.LENDIN_FPRICE_AMT , T2.LENDIN_INT_AMT, T3.FEE_AMT dealFeeAmt, T4.FEE_AMT settFeeAmt, T6.PRICE_MODEL, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, T6.PRICE , T7.MATURE_YIELD , T7.EXER_YIELD, (select sec_acct_name from stl_sec_acct_info where stl_sec_acct_info.sec_acct_id = T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID) as secAcctName, T8.PORTFOLIO_NAME, NVL(T6.ENTRUST_NUM, 0)*100 - NVL(T9.FINISH_AMT,0) - NVL(T10.ENT_FINISH_AMT,0)*100 avaNum, T1.CPRICE_AMT , T1.FPRICE_AMT , T1.INT_AMT FROM REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T2.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN REG_TRADE_FEE T3 ON T3.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T3.FEE_TYPE = 'B06' LEFT JOIN REG_TRADE_FEE T4 ON T4.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T4.FEE_TYPE = 'B08' LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST T6 ON T6.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T7 ON T7.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T8 ON T8.PORTFOLIO_ID = T6.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_QUOTE_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) T9 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T9.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN( SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT, SUM(ENT_FINISH_AMT) AS ENT_FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) T10 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T10.ENTRUST_ID where T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{quoteId}

SELECT T1.ENTRUST_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T5.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SHARE_AMT*100 SHARE_AMT, T1.INV_AIM businessModel, T2.OUR_SHARE_AMT * 100 OUR_SHARE_AMT, T2.OUR_CPRICE_AMT , T2.OUR_FPRICE_AMT , T2.OUR_INT_AMT, T2.LENDIN_SHARE_AMT * 100, T2.LENDIN_CPRICE_AMT , T2.LENDIN_FPRICE_AMT , T2.LENDIN_INT_AMT, T3.FEE_AMT dealFeeAmt, T4.FEE_AMT settFeeAmt, T6.PRICE_MODEL, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, T6.PRICE , T7.MATURE_YIELD , T7.EXER_YIELD, (select sec_acct_name from stl_sec_acct_info where stl_sec_acct_info.sec_acct_id = T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID) as secAcctName, T8.PORTFOLIO_NAME, NVL(T6.ENTRUST_NUM, 0)*100 - NVL(T9.FINISH_AMT,0) - NVL(T10.ENT_FINISH_AMT,0)*100 avaNum, T1.CPRICE_AMT , T1.FPRICE_AMT , T1.INT_AMT FROM WFL_REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2 ON T2.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_REG_TRADE_FEE T3 ON T3.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T3.FEE_TYPE = 'B06' LEFT JOIN WFL_REG_TRADE_FEE T4 ON T4.TRADE_ID = T1.TRADE_ID AND T4.FEE_TYPE = 'B08' LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T5 ON T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST T6 ON T6.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T7 ON T7.ENTRUST_ID = T1.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T8 ON T8.PORTFOLIO_ID = T6.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_QUOTE_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) T9 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T9.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN( SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT, SUM(ENT_FINISH_AMT) AS ENT_FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) T10 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T10.ENTRUST_ID where T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{quoteId}
